html_title: StreetZim — Amamephu e-Kiwix asebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
meta_description: Amamephu e-OpenStreetMap amahhala, asebenza ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, enzelwe isifundi se-Kiwix. Amathayili e-vector, izithombe zesathelayithi, isimo somhlaba se-3D nolwazi lwe-Wikipedia — kusebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwi-inthanethi ku-iOS, Android, Mac, Windows naku-Linux.
tagline: Amamephu e-OpenStreetMap asebenza ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, enzelwe isifundi se-Kiwix. Amathayili e-vector, izithombe zesathelayithi, isimo somhlaba se-3D ne-Wikipedia — akudingeki ukuxhumeka kwi-inthanethi.
maps_intro: Khetha isifunda ngezansi, ufake i-Kiwix, bese uvula ifayela le-.zim. Amafayela agcinwe ku-Internet Archive — ukulanda ngakunye kuhambisana ne-torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Khetha isifunda ngezansi bese usilanda ngesiZulu: amalebula emephu, ukusesha ne-Wikipedia kungesiZulu. Vula ifayela ku-Kiwix, i-app yamahhala; ikhasi lemephu ngayinye likhombisa ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
badge_overture_desc: amawebhusayithi, izinombolo zocingo nezinkundla zokuxhumana okuvela ku-Overture,
what_lead: I-StreetZim ipakisha idatha ye-OpenStreetMap — amazwe aphelele noma amazwekazi — ibe yifayela elilodwa le-ZIM ongalivula ku-Kiwix. Isebenza ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: awekho amaseva, azikho izicelo ze-API, futhi i-inthanethi ayidingeki ngemva kokulanda kokuqala.
what_p2: Ngokungafani nezinhlelo zamamephu ezijwayelekile ezisebenzisa amathayili e-raster, i-StreetZim isebenzisa amathayili e-vector adwetshwa kudivayisi yakho nge-MapLibre GL JS. Umphumela: ukuhambisa, ukusondeza nokuzungezisa imephu kahle, ngisho nesimo somhlaba se-3D — konke kuvela efayeleni elilodwa elikudivayisi yakho.
feat_vector_p: Amamephu acacile, abushelelezi aze afike ezingeni lomgwaqo, asebenzisa uhlaka lwe-OpenMapTiles, adwetshwa bukhoma yi-MapLibre.
feat_sat_p: Izithombe ze-Sentinel-2 ezingenamafu, ezinemininingwane engamamitha ayi-10, zaso sonke isifunda esisemephwini.
feat_terrain_p: Izithunzi zezintaba nokuphakama kwe-3D okuvela ku-Copernicus GLO-30, imodeli yomhlaba wonke yokuphakama.
feat_wiki_p: Thepha noma yiliphi idolobha, intaba noma indawo ephawulekayo ukuze ubone isihloko sayo se-Wikipedia namaqiniso abalulekile.
feat_search_p: Sesha ezigidini zamagama ezindawo, imigwaqo, amapaki, iziqongo zezintaba, izikhumulo zezindiza nezindawo ezithakazelisayo.
feat_offline_p: Ifayela elilodwa le-.zim kuphela. Awekho ama-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha, akukho nethiwekhi. Vula bese uyaqhubeka.
step1_p: Isifundi samahhala se-iOS, Android, Mac, Windows ne-Linux. Sithole ku-kiwix.org. Ku-Windows naku-Linux, okwamanje vula amamephu ku-Kiwix PWA: i-Kiwix Desktop 2.5 iwakhombisa engenalutho, futhi ukulungiswa kwalokho kusatholakala kuphela ezinguqulweni zansuku zonke (nightly).
step2_p: Khetha isifunda ngenhla bese ulanda ifayela le-.zim (noma usebenzise i-torrent ukuze kusheshe).
step2_p_lang: Khetha isifunda ngenhla bese ucindezela inkinobho yaso yokulanda: uthola imephu ngesiZulu, iyifayela elilodwa le-.zim.
step3_p: Vula ifayela le-.zim ku-app ye-Kiwix. Yilokho kuphela — imephu isebenza ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
sources_intro: I-StreetZim yakhiwe ngokuphelele ngedatha evulekile. I-ZIM yemephu ngayinye iqukethe okuvela kule mithombo:
src_map: Idatha yemephu: © Abanikeli be-OpenStreetMap, itholakala ngaphansi kwe-Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Izithombe zesathelayithi: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, okokusetshenziswa okungekona okwezohwebo kuphela.
src_elev: Ukuphakama komhlaba: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, kuhlinzekwe ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-COPERNICUS yi-European Union ne-ESA.
src_place: Ulwazi lwendawo: Wikidata (CC0) ne-Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: I-StreetZim incike ezinhlelweni zokufunda ze-Kiwix ukuze kuvulwe amafayela e-.zim. Uhlelo ngalunye lungumthombo ovulekile futhi lwakhiwa ku-GitHub:
footer: I-StreetZim iyiphrojekthi yomthombo ovulekile. Ikhodi iku-GitHub. Amamephu agcinwe ku-Internet Archive.
card_preview_title: Buka le mephu esipheqululini sakho, ithunyelwa isuka ku-archive.org
card_languages_title: Le mephu enamalebula ne-Wikipedia ngolunye ulimi, ihlanganiswa esipheqululini sakho
card_download_lang_title: Le mephu enamalebula, ukusesha ne-Wikipedia ngesiZulu, iyifayela elilodwa le-.zim
card_original_title: Imephu njengoba yakhiwe: amagama ezindawo ngolimi lwendawo; isixhumi esibonakalayo ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgisi
card_no_lang: Ayikatholakali ngesiZulu: le mephu inamagama ezindawo ngolimi lwendawo nesixhumi esibonakalayo sesiNgisi.
mp_meta_description: Imephu yamahhala engadingi i-inthanethi ye-{name}, ye-app ye-Kiwix: imigwaqo, izindawo, ukusesha, imizila ne-Wikipedia, ngesiZulu. Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi ku-Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows naku-Linux.
mp_lead: Imephu yamahhala ye-{name} esebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwi-inthanethi, ku-app ye-Kiwix.
mp_feat_nav: Imizila yokuhamba ngezinyawo, ngebhayisikili nangemoto, ebalwa kudivayisi yakho.
mp_feat_overture: Izitolo, izindawo zokudlela nezinye izindawo, namawebhusayithi nezinombolo zocingo zazo.
mp_feat_wiki: Izihloko ze-Wikipedia zamadolobha, izindawo eziphawulekayo nezindawo ezibukwayo.
mp_feat_photo: Sesha ngesithombe: thatha isithombe sophawu olubhaliwe ukuze uthole leyo ndawo emephini.
mp_dl_lang_note: Amalebula emephu, ukusesha ne-Wikipedia ngesiZulu, efayeleni elilodwa le-Kiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Imephu njengoba yakhiwe: amagama ezindawo ngolimi lwendawo; isixhumi esibonakalayo ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgisi.
mp_space_note: Ngaphambi kokulanda, hlola ukuthi idivayisi yakho inesikhala esanele. Amamephu amakhulu alandeka kangcono nge-Wi-Fi.
kg_android_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela ku-Google Play. Imahhala.
kg_android_2: Landa imephu engenhla. Ifoni yakho iyigcina ku-Downloads.
kg_android_3: Vula i-Kiwix, uye kumtapo wayo bese wengeza ifayela olilandile.
kg_ios_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela ku-App Store. Imahhala.
kg_ios_2: Landa imephu engenhla. I-Safari iyigcina ku-app ye-Files, ngaphansi kwe-Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Vula i-Kiwix, uye kumtapo wayo bese uvula ifayela eliku-Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Faka i-Kiwix evela ku-Mac App Store, bese uvula ngayo ifayela olilandile.
kg_pc_1: Vula i-app yewebhu ye-Kiwix esipheqululini sakho bese ukhetha ifayela olilandile. I-Kiwix Desktop 2.5 ikhombisa lawa mamephu engenalutho; ukulungiswa kwalokho kusatholakala kuphela ezinguqulweni zansuku zonke (nightly).
kg_offline: Ngemva kwalokho, imephu isebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwi-inthanethi.
tour_lead: Konke okukulezi ziqeshana zevidiyo kusebenza ngefayela elilodwa elikudivayisi. Kwaqoshwa i-inthanethi inqanyuliwe; kwengezwe kamuva kuphela amazwibela namachashazi akhombisa lapho isikrini sithintwe khona.
tour_photo_p: Thatha isithombe sophawu lomgwaqo, sebhodi lesitolo noma sekheli elisekhadini lokhiye wehhotela, bese imephu ifuna indawo ebhalwe kulo. Umbhalo ufundwa kudivayisi yakho, ngohlamvu olubhalwe ngalo: lapha isi-Ukraine, isiGriki, isi-Arabhu, isiJapane, isiKorea, isiShayina nesiNgisi, kubekwe eceleni kwakunye.
tour_zoom_h: Kusuka edolobheni lonke kuya esakhiweni esisodwa
tour_zoom_p: Amamephu e-vector ahlala ecacile kuwo wonke amazinga okusondeza: suka ku-Kyiv yonke uze ufike esakhiweni esisodwa, bese utshekisa futhi uzungezisa imephu.
tour_drive_p: Umzila onqamula i-Kyiv, obalwe efonini futhi walandelwa ijika ngejika. Kuqoshwe ngendawo yokulingisa; ingxenye ephakathi yohambo idlalwa ngesivinini esiphindwe kayishumi.
tour_terrain_p: Izithunzi zezintaba, isimo somhlaba se-3D nezithombe zesathelayithi: izintaba ezingenhla kwe-Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Ukusesha okufanayo ngohlobo ngalunye lombhalo, emephini yedolobha lapho uphawu lumi khona.
tour_credits: Izithombe zezimpawu, isithombe sesango nezithombe zesathelayithi ezikulezi ziqeshana nezithombe-skrini ngezabanye: bheka ababongwayo namalayisense.
gallery_lead: Izikrini zangempela zamamephu, kukhompyutha nasefonini. Khetha esisodwa ukuze usibone ngobukhulu obugcwele, bese uphenya ezinye.
langs_lead: Amagama ezindawo, ukusesha, izikhombisi-ndlela, izihloko ze-Wikipedia namamenyu emephu uqobo, ngolimi olufundayo. Kufaka phakathi imibhalo ebhalwa kusuka kwesokudla kuya kwesobunxele.
langs_step1_p: Lukhethe ohlwini olungezansi, noma kumenyu ephezulu kunoma yiliphi ikhasi.
langs_step2_p: Ekhasini lolimi lwakho, inkinobho enkulu yemephu ngayinye ilanda imephu ngalolo limi, iyifayela elilodwa le-.zim. Leli khasi lesiNgisi linikeza imephu ngayinye njengoba yakhiwe: amagama ezindawo ngolimi lwendawo, isixhumi esibonakalayo ne-Wikipedia ngesiNgisi.
langs_step2_p_lang: Kuleli khasi, inkinobho enkulu yemephu ngayinye ithi “Landa ngesiZulu”: imephu enamagama ezindawo, ukusesha, i-Wikipedia namamenyu ngesiZulu, iyifayela elilodwa le-.zim. Uma imephu ingakalungi ngesiZulu, ikhadi layo liyakusho lokho.
langs_step3_p: Amamephu amaningi angenziwa nangezilimi ezikhulunywa lapho, njengesiCatalan se-Iberia noma isiWelsh seBrithani ne-Ireland. Ikhasi elithi Amamephu ngezinye izilimi libala zonke izilimi zemephu ngayinye futhi lihlanganisa ifayela esipheqululini sakho.
langs_demo_note: Imephu efanayo ye-Kyiv ngesi-Arabhu, isiHebheru, isiHindi, isiThai, isiJapane nesiShayina. Igama elingenayo inguqulo lihlala linjengoba libhalwa endaweni yalo.
langs_grid_note: Inombolo ikhombisa ukuthi mangaki amamephu aselungile ngalolo limi namuhla.
filter_none: Ayikho imephu ehambisana nalokho. Zama izwe, isifunda noma idolobha.
credits_intro: Iziqeshana zevidiyo nezithombe-skrini zikhombisa amamephu njengoba enjalo. Izimpawu ezisekusesheni ngesithombe, isithombe esisodwa sendawo ephawulekayo nezithombe zesathelayithi kungumsebenzi wabanye, kusetshenziswe ngaphansi kwala malayisense. Izithombe zezimpawu zisikiwe.
